title: Hazard Tape
about: Lauren turning me and my knee scooter into a walking construction zone with hazard tape.
description: This track remembers a running joke that started when Lauren found a roll of yellow-and-black hazard tape and decided my knee scooter, and eventually I, needed to become a walking construction zone. She wrapped the scooter, my arms, and even made me a hazard-tape necktie. Paul shook his head, Shawn laughed, and I rolled around wearing it proudly for days. Looking back, the ridiculous prank also feels like one of the moments where a lasting friendship began.

Lyrics: Verse 1
Rolled around on a knee scooter,
Trying not to be too slow.
Every hallway knew my tires,
Every face I'd come to know.
Then Lauren found a roll one day,
Bright yellow with a warning stripe.
She looked at me and started grinning...
I should've known what she'd have in mind.
Pre-Chorus
One strip here, another there,
Pretty soon it was everywhere.
Chorus
Wrapped in hazard tape,
Like a walking construction zone.
Scooter, arms, and even me,
No one could say I was unknown.
She even made a necktie too,
Out of caution black and gold.
Everybody stopped and laughed,
It's still one of my favorite stories told.
Verse 2
Paul walked by and shook his head,
Shawn just laughed instead.
No one said to take it off,
They just smiled and kept it fun.
So for days I wore it proud,
Rolling through the busy crowd.
Hard to miss a warning sign
When the warning sign is alive.
Pre-Chorus
Didn't know it at the time,
We were writing future lines.
Chorus
Wrapped in hazard tape,
Like a walking construction zone.
Scooter, arms, and even me,
No one could say I was unknown.
She even made a necktie too,
Out of caution black and gold.
Everybody stopped and laughed,
It's still one of my favorite stories told.
Bridge
Funny how a little joke
Can outlast the years somehow.
Looking back, I almost think
That's where our friendship started out.
Not with speeches, not with plans,
Just laughter filling up the halls.
Final Chorus
Wrapped in hazard tape,
Brighter than the stage lights shined.
Who would've guessed a silly prank
Would stay with me all this time?
Every time I think back now,
That yellow tape still makes me grin.
Some friendships don't begin with words...
They start with someone making you ridiculous.
